overall: The AG found the Housing Authority violated the Open Meeting Law by holding a March 29 meeting with only same-day notice, because it did not justify an emergency and did not respond to the complaint.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Authority held an improper emergency meeting on March 29 after posting notice only that morning for a 4:00 P.M. meeting.
allegations.key_passage: we find that there was no valid emergency basis for the March 29 meeting and therefore the Authority violated the Open Meeting Law by convening this meeting without posting notice 48 hours in advance of the meeting.

remedy: We order the Authority’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
we order all members of the Authority to attend an Open Meeting Law webinar training provided by our office within 90 days of the Authority’s receipt of this letter.
we order the Authority to release the minutes of the March 29 meeting to the complainant, if it has not already done so.
